conventions.coords: UZDoom map coordinates: +x east, +y south (as in geometry_v5.py and cistern.udmf)
conventions.normal_deg: 0 = east (+x), 90 = south (+y), 180 = west (-x), 270 = north (-y); outward from the footprint
conventions.footprint: simple polygon in local units; order-independent (validator uses ray casts)
conventions.socket_width: >= 128 u; the generator snaps its own 128 u segment to the socket centre and tangent
conventions.step_riser: <= 24 u; the slice's stair risers are 8 u over 32 u treads
conventions.headroom: >= 60 u (player height 60 u); player radius 12 u
conventions.light_band: [min, max] of the slice's +/-8 u per-room jitter, clamped 64..208

generator_contract.expected_fields: template_id, tags, size_xy_u, headroom_u, light_level, material, pillars_local_xy_r, baffle_local_seg, default_landmark (Argon ChunkTemplate) plus footprint_local_u, sockets, floor_z_u, ceiling_z_u, light_band, mechanisms, encounter, rarity_weight, landmark_text
generator_contract.socket_matching: snap socket to socket by centre and tangent; verify the two floor z values are within one step (<= 24 u) unless a stair/lift/drop link carries the change
generator_contract.encounter_placement: ARMATURE_PACK rooms get an interior dogleg baffle; HOLLOW_REDEAD_BAY rooms must sit at a convergence (>= 3 sockets); never fight_required on a 128 u choke
generator_contract.wayfinding: transom states on sockets follow WAYFINDING.md: steady / flicker / dark_clean / dark_dust; never a lit transom on a dead end or optional room

The ReDead walks and reaches, grips hard, shrieks when its mask is lifted; it keeps the player busy while the Hollow comes alive.
